description: This file is a script for running Vitest profiling in a Node.js environment. It includes functions to parse command-line arguments, determine the profiling output directory, and build the command to execute Vitest with profiling options. The main function orchestrates these steps and runs the process, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, resolves output directory, creates it, builds the Vitest command, and executes it, handling errors.
